title: Tennessee is set to execute a woman for the first time in 200 years - NPR
description: One of the youngest women sent to death row is set to be executed in Tennessee. If carried out as scheduled Wednesday, it would be Tennessee's first execution of a woman in 200 years.

title: Mayor Zohran Mamdani Refuses Jimmy Kimmel’s Request to Text Trump a Selfie of Them - Variety
description: The popular mayor of New York City helped kick off a week of “Jimmy Kimmel Live” shows in Brooklyn.

title: New York Times executive fatally shot allegedly by elderly in-laws - bbc.com
description: Jonathan McKinsey's in-laws, who are both 77 years old, face multiple charges including first-degree murder.

title: New potent street drug prompts Hawaii health alert - Hawaii News Now
description: Cychlorphine, a synthetic opioid up to 10 times stronger than fentanyl, has caused deaths across the U.S., prompting local officials to prepare for its arrival.
